newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-ENTERTAINMENT PRICES ROSE MOST OVER YEAR TO MAY.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-ENTERTAINMENT PRICES ROSE MOST OVER YEAR TO MAY.

text.p: Entertainment prices have risen the most over the last year to May at 22 percent with transport and communications following with a yearly rise of 15.3 percent, the statistics office said on Friday.
It earlier said that May monthly inflation came in at two percent for a year-on-year rise of 10.8 percent.
Food prices over the last year increased by 10.8 percent and housing costs rose by 14.1 percent, the statistics office said in a statement.
Following recent trends over the past year, administratively regulated prices rose the most for an increase of 14.7 percent compared to unregulated prices which increased by 8.5 percent.
The biggest increase over the month of May was housing costs which rose by 4.3 percent. On the other hand, health costs rose by only 0.1 percent.
